why_not_well_powered.interpretation: The reported MDE is the pooled-test MDE only; the pre-registered verdict requires >=2/3 windows, both clusterings and point >= MDE, for which power at the reported MDE is far below 80%.

artifact_summary.interpretation_note: Under a valid null the randomised graph is expected to score at or below the real graph if the real relational structure carries information, and to score above it if the real graph is worse than chance-conditional-on-margins. A high randomised AP is a statement about the real graph, not evidence that random relations predict.

h2.criterion_d_only_note: H2 SUPPORTED also requires H1 SUPPORTED (PRE_REGISTRATION.md section 11); this field covers criterion (d) only. rule_level.note: Power of the compound section-11 rule; covariance from the joint company-cluster bootstrap, pair-clustered pooled statistic assumed perfectly correlated. This is the power that matters for the pre-registered H1 verdict.

mean_over_windows.note: Equal weight per holdout window; avoids giving a company-track pair with 3 overlapping windows three times the row weight of a pair observed in one window.

multiplicity.note: Pre-registration section 10.5 defines the family as H1 3 windows + pooled and H2 3 windows; the original script instead used 2 horizons x (pooled + 3 windows) = 8 H1 tests. Both families are reported here.
